request.spec:
A change that alters any person's overdue-total is now also followed by the rollup lines, and
every ROLLUP line gains overdue-total=<overdue-total> at its end, every TOTALS line
overdue-total=<total> at its end (a TOTALS line is written when any of its three totals moved).
A change of the sheet's today that puts a claim past its due-by, or takes one out of overdue, is
such a change even when no due or due-total moved.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A change that alters any person's overdue-total is now also followed by the rollup lines, and
every ROLLUP line gains overdue-total=<overdue-total> at its end, every TOTALS line
overdue-total=<total> at its end (a TOTALS line is written when any of its three totals moved).
A change of the sheet's today that puts a claim past its due-by, or takes one out of overdue, is

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The rollup audit lines now include overdue totals, and all 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

The whole change is in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/rollup/RollupService.java`; nothing else needed touching:

- **What's counted:** the server now works out each person's overdue-total the same way the screen does. It adds up the due, late charge included, of each counted claim that is open or pending and past its due-by. The sheet's overdue-total is everyone's added together.
- **When lines are written:** a ROLLUP line is now written when a person's overdue-total moves, even if their claimed and due-total stay the same. A TOTALS line is written when any of its three totals moves.
- **Line format:** ROLLUP lines end with `overdue-total=<…>` and TOTALS lines with `overdue-total=<…>`, added at the end so the existing fields keep their order.
- **Changing the sheet's today:** this already compared the figures before and after, so a new today that puts a claim into or out of overdue now writes the lines with no extra code.
